verdict.rationale: Expensify publishes a documented public Integration Server API. It supports partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret credentials for server-to-server use and OAuth2 authorization-code flow for acting on behalf of users. The docs say it can programmatically download expense report data, provision accounts for new hires, "and much more." Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint-level coverage for core write actions (creating, approving, and reimbursing expenses via API), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and an AI-friendly machine-readable docs format (the .md probe returned 404).
